comparison.objective: Form a two-bend 45-degree offset in tubing and place it on a template.
comparison.physical_skill: Tube registration, forceful bender operation, springback compensation and reorientation.
comparison.success_condition: Two opposite bends within tolerance, parallel ends, template fit and hands clear; overbend is failure. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled permanent deformation with a hand tool, unrelated to sifting dynamics.
